newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Gov. rejects conditions for $306 mln grant.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Gov. rejects conditions for $306 mln grant.

text.p: California's governor on Thursday rejected conditions set by federal officials to provide special education services to convicted felons, putting a $306 million federal grant at risk.

Republican Gov. Pete Wilson said he would not adhere to the demands set by the U.S. Department of Education, which had threatened California with the loss of the entire grant unless the state agreed to divert special education services to adults incarcerated in state prisons.
"California rejects the condition," Wilson said in a statement.
The $306 million federal grant was awarded to the state for the 1997 fiscal year under the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act, according to Wilson's office.
If the Department of Education were to recoup the entire grant, Wilson said the state would be forced to divert education funds from other programs to backfill the loss.
